labels.caption: Fig. 3. End-to-end cost on 16 confirmation weeks (trace lender, overflow accounting; all-fallback: 35,010 USD/week, median). (a) Medians; whiskers: range over the 16 weeks; segments: component medians, scaled; routing: white hairline (at most 0.0153); markers: as in (c); provision for peak: 24.3. (b) Per week, the least primary baseline minus Sublet (positive: Sublet costs less): trace cost, also with demand one slot late (16 of 16 weeks positive; 0.020 to 0.104), and W0; RetroRenting, τ≥1 h, minus Sublet: W0; shaded: negative margin. (c) Medians; named in blue: Sublet, critical-ratio planning and critical-ratio renting with one part changed; arrows: notice layer added; grey: all-fallback.

layout.rule: (a): reserve = widest bar name + the key markers' column; axes = bars + fig4_v2's label column; (b) the standard reserve; (c): reserve = widest name line (names wrapped at 0.67 in) + 2 + 7 + 12 pt (the gutter after (b), where (c)'s slot starts), y axis in a right reserve of 0.43 in; the axes share the rest in the ratios [1.0, 1.2, 1.08], (b) at least its keys' width right of its letter (3 pt after the letter, 6 pt before (b)'s axes end). Heights: the letters' line 0.12 in below the top; (a)'s top on it (lower by BL0a's label room where x_hi > 1); the keys of (b) and (c) start level with their letters; (b)'s upper sub-panel and (c) 3 pt below the deeper key's ink; (b)'s lower key's ink 11 pt below the upper sub-panel, its sub-panel 3 pt below it; the two sub-panels of one height; the keys measured as the PDF sets them, by their ink
